title: Spectacular Jewish Tour in Jaén
text: The tour was about Jaen Jewry, it was a tour for ourselves. The guide great and very nice, was an hour and a half as indicated. It's not the first tour we've done but we'll definitely repeat again

title: Jaen unknown
text: Guide with gift of people who made the journey through Jaén very interesting, with a great knowledge of history and many legends and anecdotes to remember. Guided tours are certainly essential to understand the corners of Jaén.

title: Highly recommended
text: Very pleasant and pleasant visit, with special mention to our guide Ana who is wonderful, with her explanations and her kindness

title: Recommended

title: A city that surprises
text: A very interesting tour and the excellent guide, very friendly, collaborator.  A tour with the most interesting sites.
author: AnaN2253

title: Jaen Tour with Ana
text:
We did a guided tour with Ana. We enjoyed all its explanations and discovered that Jaén is a wonderful city with a lot of history and art.
Thank you very much Ana!!
author: Pedrogon007

title: Magnificent visit to know Jaén
text: We have passed through Jaén and decided to arrange a guided tour with Claritas. It has been quite a success, as Maria, our guide, has explained everything very well, interacting with us. So for us, Jaén is no longer a stranger.
author: jodigo82

title: Recommended 100%
text: Tour guides there are many, but that put as much passion as Kevin there is less. Attention of 10, we were with our dog Coco and found us a wonderful caretaker to stay with him while we calmly made our route to discover the historic center. The route very complete and entering the emblematic sites of Jaén with their corresponding explanations. We are already thinking of going back to the city another time to discover other routes with him. Thanks to you and Luna for everything.
author: mercedesa573

title: Very well spent time.
text: We have visited Jaén with our adult children. The activity perfectly organized by Kevin and carried out by Natalia who, kindly and cheerfully has informed us more than enough of everything; you cannot ask for more.
author: PepeParadores

title: Discovering Jaén
text: All very well explained, an ideal route to know well the historical part of Jaén. Highly recommended.
